name: vita_cpu_tweaks
description: Enable the PS Vita's Cortex-A9/PL310 hardware prefetchers via a simple taiHEN config.txt plugin + text config file
long_description: A taiHEN kernel plugin that turns on the PS Vita's hardware data prefetchers. The firmware switches them off at every boot: the Cortex-A9's L2 prefetch hint and the PL310 L2 cache controller's data prefetch. With them on, memory reads that miss the cache get up to 3× faster. Every prefetch-related register field has its own key in a plain INI config file, so you never need to rebuild anything.
